laws.rule: Phu Quoc island has its own visa exemption: a foreign passport holder may stay on Phu Quoc for up to 30 days without a visa, and people transiting through another Vietnamese international gateway to reach Phu Quoc are also exempt. The exemption is for staying on Phu Quoc; travel elsewhere in Vietnam needs the national visa (eVisa).
laws.heading: Phu Quoc visa exemption (Vietnam National Authority of Tourism, 2025)

local-law.note: Phu Quoc was in Kien Giang until the 2025 provincial merger and is now in An Giang. The exemption comes from Vietnam's national entry law; it is recorded here because it applies only on Phu Quoc.

sites.what: Archaeological remains at Oc Eo in Thoai Son district include evidence of settlement and trade. Viet Nam submitted the site to UNESCO’s tentative list in 2022.
